theme: 指数与个股混合：中证1000指数行情与估值切入，话题切换至万华化学年报财务

initial.question: 帮我看看中证1000指数最新收盘在多少点？
initial.gold_sql: SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE SECCODE='000852' AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 它最近一个月整体走势怎么样，累计涨跌幅大概多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((a.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS chg_pct_1m FROM (SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1 ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) a, (SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<=(SELECT DATE_SUB(MAX(TRADEDATE),INTERVAL 1 MONTH) FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1) ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) b

feedbacks.question: 那2025年全年呢，累计涨幅有多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND((a.TCLOSE/b.TCLOSE-1)*100,2) AS chg_pct_2025 FROM (SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<='2025-12-31' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) a, (SELECT TCLOSE FROM INDX_MKT WHERE INNER_CODE=106006433 AND ISVALID=1 AND TRADEDATE<='2024-12-31' ORDER BY TRADEDATE DESC LIMIT 1) b

feedbacks.question: 现在这个指数的市盈率大概什么水平？跟上证50比谁的估值更高？
feedbacks.gold_display: 中证1000市盈率43.09倍 > 上证50市盈率10.64倍，中证1000估值明显更高
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT INDX_CNAME, PE FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE INNER_CODE IN (106006433,106000255) AND ISVALID=1 AND TRD_DATE=(SELECT MAX(TRD_DATE) FROM ANA_INDX_VAL_IDX WHERE INNER_CODE IN (106006433,106000255) AND ISVALID=1)

feedbacks.question: 明白了，谢谢。顺便确认下，这些点位和涨跌幅都是交易所收盘后公布的官方行情口径吧？
对了，再帮我查一下万华化学2025年年报的归属于母公司股东的净利润是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT F110101 FROM VIEW_STK_FIN_IDX WHERE A_STOCKCODE='600309' AND ENDDATE='2025-12-31' AND RPT_SRC='年报' AND ISVALID=1
